title: ActionEffects
description: Data files content/effects/*.json: what an action does, decided by the TRUE properties of the target (the world knows the truth). An action without a target uses rules with requires_property null. All numbers are placeholders until Marcel decides.

event_effects.description: What a core event does to the inhabitant it is about (W1744): when an event of the kind is reported, its effects reach that inhabitant right away. Events without an inhabitant (weather, player) reach nobody. Omitted = no event has an effect.

detail_ends_with.description: Only events whose language-neutral detail ends with this text (e.g. '/experienced' for knowledge_gained, whose detail is property/source). Omitted = every event of the kind.

effects.description: Effects on the event's inhabitant; listener_share has no meaning here and is refused at load.

reach_m.description: Distance to the target at which the action can start.

destination.description: Where an action without a target happens: here, at a random spot within the perception radius (own seed stream), or at the frontier: the nearest walkable cell the inhabitant has seen that lies next to one it has not seen yet (B2-6 R14). A frontier action is only offered while such a cell can be reached on foot.

decider_option.description: Whether the decider may offer this action as an option (default true). Actions the core plans itself, such as building steps, are false.

requires_property.description: True property the target must have; null for actions without a target.

requires_also.description: B2668: a second true property the target must have as well (e.g. crafted: only made things); omitted or null = none.

id.description: Need or mood id; ignored for will_to_live.

listener_share.description: Share of the delta the other participant of an action aimed at an inhabitant (the listener) gets as well, 0..1 (TL #20190); omitted = 0, only the actor.
